check_grammar.note: Every check declares a `type`, an `evidence` label and its expectations. Unknown `type` → the preflight fails closed (exit 2). `expect` is ALL-OF over listed field/value pairs. `expect_any` is ONE-OF over listed objects (each object itself ALL-OF). When both are present, the result is expect AND expect_any. `composite.all` → every sub-check must pass; `composite.any` → at least one. A `manual` check always yields `cannot_evaluate` unless a recorded manual verification for its id is present and not past `next_due`, in which case it yields `manually_verified`.

evidence_labels.settings-read: A platform setting was read and compared. Proves the setting; not the behavior.
evidence_labels.presence: A file, directory or workflow element exists. Proves existence only.
evidence_labels.content: Inside a file matched a declared assertion. Proves the assertion; not the semantics.
evidence_labels.manual: A person must look and record that they did.

exit_policy.0: every required item is pass, manually_verified (not past due), not_applicable, or exception_active (approved, unexpired); the standard's currency is known
exit_policy.1: any required item is missing, drifted, cannot_evaluate, exception_expired or exception_unapproved; OR currency_unknown; OR the standard's review_by date has passed
exit_policy.2: the standard could not be loaded, is empty, has an unknown check type, or the stamp is malformed
exit_policy.recommended_items: never change the exit code; always appear in the report

check.permitted_creation_modes: owners-only, or members may create private repositories only; members_can_create_private_repositories may be true or false; members_can_create_internal_repositories must be false where the field exists

organization.title: Private by default; default branch main

check.prompt: Organization settings → Repository defaults: default branch is 'main'; new repositories default to private. Record date and who checked.

all.exclusions_from: applied.md exceptions with id ORG-04 naming the repository

organization.title: Dependabot alerts and security updates on every repository

all.meaning: 204 = alerts enabled for this repository; 404 = disabled

organization.title: Secret scanning and push protection where the plan allows
organization.relationship: If this item is not pass, REPO-07 must be pass in every repository AND an approved exception for ORG-06 must exist in applied.md. The report states 'detection only — no push protection' when this condition holds.

organization.title: .github repository with default files that have content

all.meaning: a working contact address is present

all.prompt: Confirm the organization's default files are visible from a private repository that has none of its own.

check.prompt: Review members, outside collaborators, installed apps and tokens; look at the audit log; record date, who, and what changed in applied.md.

repository.title: Private; default branch main; auto-delete head branches
Default branch requires PR and the repository's own named checks

all.meaning: every check named in the stamp is required on the default branch

all.prompt: If more than one person has write access, confirm one approving review is required (required_approving_review_count ≥ 1). With one maintainer, record that the human merge is the control.

repository.title: CI runs the gates as ordered steps on PR and push

check.meaning: the repository declares its gate commands in the stamp (e.g. ['pnpm check','pnpm test','pnpm test:integration','pnpm build']); each must appear as its own step, in that order, in one job

repository.title: No secret lands unnoticed; scanner is a required check

all.expect_history_depth: fetch-depth: 0 on the scan job, or a documented depth in the stamp

all.prompt: Confirm the one-time history scan at adoption is recorded (date, tool, result) and any exposed credential was rotated (date). Record in the stamp's manual_verifications.

all.requirements_txt_rule: every non-comment line contains '==' or a hash

repository.title: Database changes only via committed migrations

any.prompt: Unrecognized database layout: attest that schema changes land only from committed migration files and name the path.

all.prompt: Read AGENTS.md: it must instruct (not merely mention) verify-before-acting, propose-before-changing, one change per verified step, stop at pull-request-open with a human merge, no unrequested scope, and 'not verified' never reported as passing.

all.meaning: a report artifact exists for the current head commit

repository.title: Deployment verified by address and source commit, recorded

check.prompt: At each release: record the deployment address and its source SHA in the release notes; confirm they match the merged commit.

stamp_schema.$comment: Validation schema for .house-standard.json in a repository (and for organization rows in applied.md). Unknown top-level properties are rejected.

digest.$comment: SHA-256 of the published house-standard.json this stamp was applied against

required_checks.$comment: the CI job names that must be required on the default branch; must include 'preflight'

gate_commands.$comment: ordered gate commands REPO-04 checks for, e.g. pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm test:integration, pnpm build

approved_by.$comment: must be the CODEOWNERS maintainer (repository tier) or the organization owner (organization tier)

expires.$comment: ≤ 90 days after approved_on; validated by the preflight

opens_review_when: a required item is missing or disabled
a required item is drifted (present but not as required)
the stamp version or digest is older than / differs from the source of truth
the standard's currency is unknown (source of truth unreachable)
the standard's review_by date has passed
an exception is requested, lacks approval fields, or has expired
a manual verification is past next_due
a Dependabot alert of severity high or critical is open on a dependency named in this standard's own tooling (input: repos/{org}/{repo}/dependabot/alerts?state=open)

review_item.in_a_repository: one GitHub issue per finding id, labeled house-standard, assigned to the CODEOWNERS maintainer; idempotent — skipped while an open issue for that id exists
review_item.in_the_organization_log: a dated row in applied.md; the maintainer's own tracking system for anything beyond that

escalation.closing_a_review_item_requires: one of: the fix (next preflight passes); an approved exception with expiry; a recorded manual verification with next_due; a proposed standard change (version bump). Closing without one of these is drift in disguise.

report_contract.summary_line: "{passed} automated checks passed; {manual} items need human verification; {findings} findings" — never the word 'compliant'
